class.name: PorchlightRuleRunner
class.brief_description: Evaluates a Porchlight rule automatically or on demand.
class.description: A scene node that manages the runtime evaluation of a [PorchlightRule]. When [member run_on_ready] is enabled, the rule is evaluated when this node becomes ready. When [member watch_progress] is enabled, the runner listens to [PorchlightProgress] and reevaluates when any milestone referenced by the rule's condition is completed, removed, or changed by [method PorchlightProgress.load_progress]. Clearing all milestones also causes reevaluation. Single conditions reference [member PorchlightCondition.milestone]. Composite conditions reference every entry in [member PorchlightCondition.milestones]. One progress reload causes at most one runner evaluation, even when several added or removed milestones are referenced by the condition. Reload changes unrelated to the condition do not cause evaluation. Rules may execute either one action or an ordered action sequence. The runner reports [code]action_changed[/code] as [code]true[/code] when at least one action executed by the rule changes persistent milestone state. When [member run_once] is enabled, a rule whose condition becomes true is not evaluated again until [method reset_runner] is called, the assigned rule is replaced, or the assigned rule or one of its active nested resources changes. A runner cannot reenter [method evaluate_rule] while an earlier evaluation is still active. This prevents its action and signal callbacks from recursively evaluating the same runner. The runner displays editor configuration warnings for missing or incomplete conditions, single actions, and action-sequence entries.

method.name: evaluate_rule
method.description: Evaluates [member rule] and executes its active action configuration if the condition is met. Returns [code]true[/code] if at least one action executed by the rule changed persistent milestone state. Returns [code]false[/code] if the rule is missing or invalid, the condition is not met, no action changes progress, [member run_once] is enabled and the rule has already run, or another evaluation is currently active on this runner. When [member run_once] is enabled, the runner is marked as having run as soon as a valid rule's condition is met, even if none of its actions change progress. Calls rejected because another evaluation is active do not emit [signal evaluated].

method.name: get_description
method.description: Returns a readable description of the assigned rule, including its active single action or ordered action sequence. Returns [code]No rule assigned.[/code] when no rule is configured. If [member run_once] is enabled and the rule has already run, the description is prefixed with [code]Rule already ran: [/code].

method.name: get_setup_warnings
method.description: Returns configuration warnings for the assigned rule. Warnings are returned when the rule, condition, required condition milestone data, active single action, action sequence, or an individual sequence entry is missing or invalid. Action-sequence warnings identify the one-based index of each invalid entry. These warnings are also displayed as node configuration warnings in the editor.

method.name: has_run_rule
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a valid rule condition has been met since the runner was last reset. This state only prevents further evaluation while [member run_once] is enabled.

method.name: reset_runner
method.description: Clears the runner's internal completed state so a rule using [member run_once] can run again. This method does not change milestone progress and does not immediately evaluate the rule.

members.member: The rule managed by this runner. Replacing the rule resets the runner's completed state. Changes to the rule or its active nested condition and action resources also reset that state and refresh editor configuration warnings.
If [code]true[/code], evaluates [member rule] when this node becomes ready at runtime.
If [code]true[/code], prevents further evaluations after the rule's condition has been met. Call [method reset_runner] to allow the rule to run again.

If [code]true[/code], listens for relevant changes from [PorchlightProgress]. Completion and removal signals are filtered through [method PorchlightCondition.references_milestone], so the rule is reevaluated whenever the changed milestone is referenced by its single or composite condition. Clearing all milestones always causes reevaluation. A [signal PorchlightProgress.progress_reloaded] event is filtered across both its added and removed milestones. The runner evaluates once when one or more affected milestones are referenced and does not evaluate for an unrelated reload. Enabling this property while the node is already inside the scene tree connects the listener and immediately evaluates the rule.

signal.name: evaluated
signal.description: Emitted when the runner evaluates a rule. [param condition_met] indicates whether the assigned condition was met. [param action_changed] indicates whether at least one action executed by the rule changed persistent milestone state. An invalid or missing rule emits both values as [code]false[/code]. A recursive evaluation attempt blocked by the reentrancy guard does not emit this signal.
